# SA Public Sector Salary Scales
## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the ASO 7 salary?
An Administrative Services ASO 7 (also written as ASO7 or Administrative Services Officer Level 7) earns $116,089 to $125,490 per year as set by the SA Public Sector Enterprise Agreement: Salaried 2026.
